The '''Museum of the Battle over Bothawui''' was a [[space station]] in orbit above the [[gas giant]] planet [[Bothawui]]. It served as a chronicle of the [[Clone Wars]], specifically the [[Battle of Bothawui]] in [[22 BBY]] where the [[Galactic Republic]] scored a decisive victory over the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] fleet led by [[General]] [[Grievous]]. The museum was attended by the repurposed [[B1-series battle droid]] [[Guy-Dee]]. It could be reached by a [[Star Commuter 2000]] shuttle from [[Nar Kaaga City]]. Shortly before the destruction of [[Hosnian Prime]], tourism at the museum was especially low because of the [[First Order]]'s presence.<ref name="HS-CB3" /> It would soon after be destroyed during a First Order attack on the station.

==History==
[[File:MuseumOfTheBattleOverBothawui-Codebreaker3.png|thumb|left|250px|Republic and Separatist artifacts on display at the Museum of the Battle over Bothawui.]]
Sometime before [[34 ABY]], [[Resistance]] pilot [[Poe Dameron]] and his faithful [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]] were on a mission to steal a piece of codebreaking technology allowing the [[First Order]] to decode encrypted Resistance transmissions from the First Order's safe house on the [[Hutt Space]] planet of [[Nar Kaaga]]. After infiltrating the safe house, Dameron discovered that the codebreaker was not a piece of technology, but rather a young [[Muun]] girl named [[Cheka]].<ref name="HS-CB1">[[Hyperspace Stories—Codebreaker 1|''Hyperspace Stories—Codebreaker'' 1]]</ref> Dameron, Cheka and BB-8 escaped the facility, but their [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] was destroyed by the First Order ace known as the [[Banshee of Bestine]]. Seeking alternate means of transport at the spaceport in [[Nar Kaaga City]], a [[RX-series pilot droid]] suggested they take the shuttle to the Museum of the Battle over Bothawui.<ref name="HS-CB3" />

Upon arrival, the trio was greeted by the museum's tour guide, [[Guy-Dee]], a repurposed [[B1-series battle droid]]. Dameron used the museum's transmitter to send a distress call to the Resistance, which was intercepted by the [[New Republic Regional Offices]] in the [[Halla sector]]. Despite the request by General [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] to be alerted to any distress calls, the corrupt [[Senator]] [[Skorshon]] instead alerted the First Order.<ref name="HS-CB3" />

The Banshee of Bestine, along with fellow ace pilot, [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]], answered the call and traveled to the [[Bothawui system]].<ref name="HS-CB3" /> The Banshee, consumed by her desire to finally destroy Poe Dameron, gave orders to her wingmen to strafe the museum, despite the objections of Major Vonreg to storm the station and capture Cheka alive. Because the museum's artifacts were kept in relatively good condition<ref name="HS-CB4">[[Hyperspace Stories—Codebreaker 4|''Hyperspace Stories—Codebreaker'' 4]]</ref>, Dameron was able to fly out in a [[Clone Z-95 starfighter]] and engage the [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE fighters]] led by the Banshee. Before leaving the station however, Poe and Guy-D concocted a scheme to set the museum's self destruct countdown, while the refurbished battle droid escaped with Cheka to [[Mygeeto]].

In battle over the station, Poe Dameron bested the Banshee as the museum's self destruct mechanism engaged, destroying the station. Soon after, the Resistance cruiser ''[[Echo of Hope]]'' arrived, based on General Organa's suspicions, and chased off Major Vonreg and the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Decimator (Resurgent-class)|''Decimator'']].
